title: PackManifest
description:
A pack's manifest, `pack.json`. Field names: the manifest is camelCase (`schemaVersion`); the
pack's YAML files and their fields are snake_case (`expect_when`, `ask_in`), as authors write
them; the app's own saved data is camelCase. The app hands pack content to its interface with
camelCase field names, so the interface reads one case (decision 0029).

$schema.description: Optional path to `pack.schema.json`, so editors offer autocomplete. Ignored by the app.

aircraft.description: The aircraft this pack is for. Required for `kind: aircraft`, refused on `kind: library`.

aliases.description: Old ids and the ids they became, so an update keeps a pilot's flight (`aliases.yaml`).

attribution.description:
Credit and terms notes. A built child carries its parents' notes first, then its own,
each once.

basisTags.description:
The `basis` tags this pack's lists may use: kinds of material, never document names. A
built child may use its parents' tags and its own: theirs first, then its own, each once.

briefings.description:
Briefings, each with its items (`briefings.yaml`), shown at the top of their phases;
Practice asks about their mnemonics.

cdu.description: CDU walkthroughs, screen by screen (`cdu.yaml`). The app doesn't show them yet.

checklists.description: Checklist files, in display order, relative to the pack folder.

contentHash.description:
Written by `involo-pack build`, never by an author: the SHA-256 of the built pack's
content (its lists and content files, flattened), in hex.

controls.description: The controls steps name, where they are, and the flight deck overview (`controls.yaml`).

engine.description: App versions this pack works with, e.g. `>=0.1, <1`.

extends.description:
The one pack this pack builds on, with the versions it accepts, e.g.
`{"lib.boeing-737": ">=1.0, <2"}`. A library can be extended but not opened on its own.
This replaces format 5's `dependencies`, which nothing read: a pack has at most one
parent, and builds on it rather than listing what it includes.

faults.description: Faults: their causes, what to do and the steps that deal with them (`faults.yaml`).

flight.description: The pack's flight fields (`flight.yaml`): what steps fill and what a SimBrief plan fills.

glossary.description: The terms and abbreviations steps use, and what each means (`glossary.yaml`).

id.description: Lower-case id with dots and dashes, e.g. `ifly-737-max8` or `lib.boeing-cdu`.

kind.description: `aircraft`, a pack a pilot opens, or `library`, shared content other packs extend.

labels.description: The words the interface shows for this pack (`labels.yaml`); without it, the app's own.

license.description:
SPDX license id for the pack content, e.g. `CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0`. A child's license is the
built pack's.

messages.description: The aircraft's alert messages (`messages.yaml`), when it has an alert display.

name.description: The pack's name as the app shows it, e.g. on the Packs page and in the catalog.

notes.description: Longer explanations for steps (What, Why, Check, If not) and How notes (`notes.yaml`).

panelStates.description:
Panel states a pilot can start from, and the steps each counts as done or skips
(`panel-states.yaml`).

patches.description: A child's changes to its parent, by id (`patches.yaml`). Only with `extends`.

phases.description: Phases, stages and options. Required for an aircraft pack.

resolved.description:
Written by `involo-pack build`, never by an author: each pack this one was built from,
the parent first, with its exact version.

schemaVersion.description:
Pack format. The app reads every format from 6 (the first public one) up to its own and
refuses an older or newer pack with the reason. From 6 on, a later format only adds.

version.description:
The pack's version, e.g. `1.2.0`. The app keeps one version of each pack and offers a
newer one as an update; raise it for each change you publish.

AircraftInfo.description:
The aircraft an aircraft pack is for (decision 0029). Required for `kind: aircraft`; a
library has none.

developer.description: Who made the simulator aircraft the pack follows.

icaoTypes.description:
The ICAO type designators the pack covers, e.g. `["B38M"]`: two to four capital letters
and digits, starting with a letter. At least one.

name.description: The aircraft as pilots name it, e.g. `737 MAX 8`.

simulator.description: The simulator the pack is written for.

PackKind.description: What a pack is: an aircraft a pilot opens, or a library other packs extend.

oneOf.description:
Shared content other packs extend (e.g. `lib.boeing-737`). It cannot be installed or
opened on its own, and has no `aircraft` block.

ResolvedParent.description: One pack a built pack was built from: its id and exact version (decision 0029).

version.description: The parent's exact version the pack was built over.
